attempts.summary: Configured NFS share of /srv/nfs/shared on node1, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, with shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) on both nodes and dataops:dataops 2770 permissions. Verified bidirectional file creation preserves consistent ownership, then restarted both nodes one at a time (node1 server first, node2 client second), confirming boot identity changes and full recovery of the NFS export, mount, and data on each.
